newsitem.title: USA: CACI sees Q4 earnings below estimates.
newsitem.headline: CACI sees Q4 earnings below estimates.

text.p: CACI International Inc said Friday it expects to report sales of $71 million, and earnings of $1.6 million or $0.14 per share in the fourth quarter, falling below the First Call consensus earnings estimate of $0.27 per share.

The company said that anticipated losses on a fixed-price contract, reduced profits from its United Kingdom subsidiary and investments made during the quarter on marketing its Year 2000 service are expected to reduce quarterly earnings by $0.12 per share.

The company estimated the pretax loss on the contract, which is with the U.S. Justice Dept., at $1.1 million, or $0.06 a share. Higher costs and lower sales of high-margin products mean that the British subsidiary will break-even, as opposed to earnings of $0.05 per share a year ago, while marketing costs of the Year 2000 program were $0.01 a share, said CACI.

For the year, the company said it expects to generate revenues of $273 million, with net income of about $10.1 million, or $0.92 per share. Fourth quarter and year-end results are expected to be reported in mid-August. The fourth quarter ends June 30.
